text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, such as organizing data or answering simple customer questions. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees save time and focus on more important work. In many jobs, human-AI collaboration is becoming normal: people and machines work together, each doing what they do best. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some tasks may disappear, while new roles will appear. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI offers great opportunities, but it also requires careful adaptation from both companies and employees.
